name: firmness
wording: how firmly a value holds: advisory, firm unless the operator overrides it, or fixed; a firm or fixed value is enforced at the most reliable place that can hold it, by permission first, then by a capability, then by a guard that checks the act, and by text only where nothing else can.
reason: Discovery 2026-10-10: enforcement levels as in policy stores; the canon held every value equally and enforced reach with model-judged guards, which are slow, costly and fallible.
